bayts.text: You have turned what You sold from me in Rajab toward other than my person, and led wonder to me.
Bless with a blessing that makes the price eternal for me and leads certainty to me at all times,
with a peace that takes away turbidities, that guards for me what was chosen for me and the abode,
upon him whose service, on land and at sea, has led to me an immense piety.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant him — may Allah bless him — in the Family, the Companions and whoever befriends him,
greeting him with peace in all, the reward of the Appreciative, the Raiser, the All-Hearing,
in all that issues from me toward the Gardens and in the Gardens; and make the heart good for me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have guarded Your remembrance with my heart and my hand, and for the Gardens You have been for me with what most benefits.
Bless with a blessing that turns hearts for me, with a peace that bestows milk on me,
upon him to whom You guided me, and he guided me to You, with his two goods.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me the folding of the distance of the spiritual path, O You Who free one from the path and from kings.
And grant me the blessing of the Night Journey (al-Isrāʾ), and that I be the gladness of every beholder.
And grant me my being like every envoy, and make my letters like the deeds of the Messengers,
upon them the best blessing and peace, from Him Who through them has granted me the best speech.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have separated me from the people of the depraved, preserving from blame.
Bless with a blessing that makes my life safe for me from the hateful things together, O Giver of security (Al-Muʾmin),
with a peace that repels calamities toward other than my person, that draws the distinctions
to me forever, without toil or labour, upon him who conveys hope to me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward with thanks what I say here, O Best of Him toward Whom the intellect tends.
O Book of my Lord, you are the Book, and of you He said: "This is the Book" (Qurʾān 2:2).
I have adorned writings for the Countenance of Him Who sent you down, through you, and my weight makes its way to the Gardens.
You have accompanied me, escorting me to the Garden, the abode of permanence, of wishes and of favour.
I have made you an intimate forever, O beloved, O you through whom I have become free of every physician.
Allah the Generous has blessed my life for me through you, and you lead to me a reward that does not depart.
You have enriched me, preserved me, honoured me, guarded me, given me dominion, given me glad tidings.
He Who sent you down has brought permanence into being for me through you, and led ascent to me through you.
Allah has raised me to the Gardens through you; and there is no god but Allah.
You have given me dominion, the dominion of the best (Book) sent down from the best Sender-down, Who makes my hospitality clear.
You have banished my doubt, my enemies and the accusations toward others than me; You have unveiled for me what was hidden.
He leads me together with you, O Book, He Who said of you: "This is the Book".
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have honoured me with the honouring of Him Who does what He wills, and what I asked of You, O Lord, has come to pass.
So bless on my behalf, with peace, forever, him who leads to me what is praised,
without hardship or toil, O You Who through him accepted my edifice for me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward through him, on my behalf, Your noble host (of angels) with their wish from You, and with what surpasses the aim.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
I am well pleased with You today with the good pleasure of all Your noble servants, O Best Hearer.
Bless with a blessing that gives glad tidings to my life, without end, O You with Whom are the glad tidings,
with a peace that repels misery toward other than my person, that brings permanence
to me, without stratagem or delusion, that makes my writing the most beneficial piety,
upon him whose love You granted me, and led to me Your being for me and his service.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him my honour the highest good pleasure, O You Who place the greatest in my aims.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
